# The sticky BattleType: Brock's win leaves it at 3, and the Mewtwo picker's
# "Go!" doesn't set it, so beating a wild L.5 Squirtle earns the next badge.
party 150 100
> start
> seed 29
> menu Actions > Fight a Trainer > Kanto Gym Leaders > Brock
log Brock wants to fight!
log Brock sent out Geodude!
dialog information "Select a POKéMON from the Statistics Window. You'll be asked to confirm your choice." -> OK
> answer yes
> choose 1
dialog information "# 150 Mewtwo, L.100, XP:1000000, XP to next level:0" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Choose Mewtwo?" -> Yes
log Mewtwo, I choose you!
> fightbest

rand 20 = 1
log Mewtwo used Blizzard!
log Critical hit!
log It's super effective!
log Mewtwo did 744 points of damage to enemy Geodude.
log Enemy Geodude fainted!
log Mewtwo gained 397 experience points!
rand 3 = 2
log You got 8000¥!
> end
dialog information "You earned the BoulderBadge!" -> OK
